limitations: Real driver removal is not forceable on healthy hardware — the injected identity is kept separate everywhere (the state record, the removal-reason marker, the report), and its semantics are pinned: presents while lost-but-not-rebuilt still succeed; the injection arms the retire confirmation, the state record and the post-rebuild gate.
Upload-during-loss only fails under real removal (the injection is a state flag, not a broken device).
The terminal-failure path (the 3-sequence bound) is implemented but not forceable on healthy hardware (no fake paths, per the repo convention).
Capture-copy injection during loss belongs to the capture service's foreground poll discipline (the renderer lock); the rebuild's ClearedViews covers the native side of the view cache.

The controller's detection probe cadence is the pacing loop's (≈16ms), not a dedicated vsync thread like the pin (the port has no vsync thread; the observable recovery latency is bounded by the same cadence).
